mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.description, p.repository_url, p.main_branch, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_version v WHERE v.project_id = p.id) AS version_count FROM dpm_project p
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.description, p.repository_url, p.main_branch, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_version v WHERE v.project_id = p.id) AS version_count FROM dpm_project p WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dpm_project (project_code, project_name, description, repository_url, main_branch, status) VALUES (#{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{repositoryUrl}, #{mainBranch}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_project SET project_code = #{request.projectCode}, project_name = #{request.projectName}, description = #{request.description}, repository_url = #{request.repositoryUrl}, main_branch = #{request.mainBranch}, status = #{request.status} WHERE id = #{id}
